title: Lausige_GUI
description: A Fancy Resource pack, for all people who match my vibe
body:
A vibrant Axolotl-themed resource pack with custom GUI elements.
Make your minecraft feel like you are an Axolotl

## Features
- Axolotl-themed XP bar
- Water bottle icons used as the hunger bar
- Rethemed hotbar
- Rethemed armor icons
